title: Clova.Email — a new email address for every company
excerpt: Give every company you deal with its own email address, all in one account. When one leaks or starts sending spam, delete it, not your life.
content_html:
Inbox types Pricing MCP Data Explainer

Zero Spam. Quiet by Design.

Infinite inboxes, so nobody ever gets your real address. Give every company its own — when one leaks, you delete it, not your life.

No card required

Three kinds of inbox

Pick one based on who you're handing the address to.

01 · One-sender

One sender, one address

The first person or company to write claims the address for good. Everyone else is rejected at the door — so a resold or breached list is worth nothing.

Chase Bank ✓ claimed it

Spamco ✕ bounced

List reseller ✕ bounced

chase@yourname.clova.email

created 24 h ✕ after

3 mails in then bounced · self-wipes

02 · Temporary

Gone when you're done

Set a lifetime — an hour for a download link, a month for a trial. When it's up the inbox turns mail away, and can wipe what it holds.

03 · Prefix

Invent one at the counter

Claim a prefix of five characters or more, then anything you add after it already works — no setup, and no dash needed. Each address still locks to its first sender.

maryann -workreceipts_personal^subscription.vet @yourname.clova.email

Free

$0

forever

  • Unlimited inboxes
  • One-sender & temporary
  • 1 permanent address
  • 1 prefix
  • 1 forwarding address*
  • 100 MB storage

Pro

$30/year

$2.50 a month, billed yearly

  • Unlimited inboxes
  • One-sender & temporary
  • 5 permanent addresses
  • 25 prefixes
  • 10 forwarding addresses*
  • 10 GB storage

Business

$50/year

$4.17 a month, billed yearly

  • Everything in Pro plus:
  • Bring your own domain
  • Any address at it
  • Unlimited permanent addresses
  • Unlimited forwarding addresses*
  • 25 GB storage

* Limits are 100 messages per day in the Free plan and 1000 in Pro and Business. Limits subject to change.

MCP

Bring your AI assistant

Connect Claude, Cursor or any assistant that speaks MCP, and hand it the inbox chores: a fresh address for a sign-up, the code that just arrived, every receipt from March. It gets only the permissions you give it.

Make me an address for the gym trial, and tell me the code they send.

create_inbox · temporary, 30 days gym-trial@yourname.clova.email

wait_for_message Your code is 482 913

Privacy & export

Your data is yours

We don't sell it, we don't read it and we don't track you. You can export your entire dataset at any time, on any plan.

Read our privacy policy

See it in a minute

How the three inbox types work together in one mailbox.

Signing in, and your data

Sign in with a Google account, a passkey, or a username and a password. With Google, Clova.Email receives only your email address, your name and your profile photo: the address is how we know it is you, and the name and photo fill in your profile, where you can change or remove them. We never use any of it for advertising, never sell it and never share it. The whole of it is in our privacy policy.
